faq.q: Can I read fuel level remotely on a Nissan Sentra?
faq.a: Yes, through a DIMO device. Query the Telemetry API with a Vehicle JWT for powertrainFuelSystemRelativeLevel (percent) or powertrainFuelSystemAbsoluteLevel (liters).

faq.q: How do I track a Nissan Sentra with no connected services?
faq.a: Use a DIMO device (the DIMO LTE R1 for this vehicle). Once the owner shares the vehicle with your Developer License, exchange your Developer JWT for a Vehicle JWT through the Token Exchange API and read its signals from the Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I detect idling on a Nissan Sentra?
faq.a: Idling comes from a DIMO device. Call the Telemetry API segments query with mechanism set to idling, which finds contiguous periods where engine RPM stays in the idle range. You can tune the upper RPM bound with maxIdleRpm, which defaults to 1000.

faq.q: How do I verify Nissan Sentra mileage?
faq.a: The odometer signal comes from a DIMO device. To get a verifiable reading, call the Attestation API at POST /v2/attestation/odometer-statement/:tokenId with a Vehicle JWT, then retrieve the resulting rawVC through the Telemetry API.

faq.q: How do I detect harsh braking on a Nissan Sentra?
faq.a: Harsh braking events come from a DIMO device. Create a webhook in the Vehicle Triggers API with service set to events and metricName behavior.harshBraking, or request HarshBraking counts per trip with eventRequests in the Telemetry API segments query.

intro: DIMO gives developers API access to vehicle-state data: diagnostics, fault codes, battery and fuel health, odometer, and maintenance signals. The Nissan Sentra is an ICE vehicle that connects through a DIMO device, the DIMO LTE R1, on 2013 and newer model years, and this coverage has been tested. Vehicle owners consent to and control sharing, so builders get data with clear provenance.
